description.silhouette: Kit master of a six by four cell timber footbridge travelling east-west on the 224 px canvas: cross boards between low curbs, handrails on posts, dressed stone abutments with a timber sill at both ends
description.colors: Watchtower timber: varied warm weathered boards with sun bleached scuffing between the curbs, damp darker margins with olive moss along the railings, matte charcoal iron splices and brackets, cool grey abutment stone
description.anatomy: Six cross boards per metre with 18 mm gaps and a joint on every whole metre; four inner and two outer stringers; curb, handrail and guard rail in one metre segments with iron splices on the cell lines; one post inside each middle cell, 170 mm newel posts at the corners; masonry joints at y = -1, 0 and 1. The runtime cuts the render along these cell lines into decks of any span and width. Key and fill keep their shared direction but stand ten times further out so that cells from both ends match in brightness.

standard.label: Watchtower timber with damp mossy deck margins
